newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany pledges donation for Bosnia election.
newsitem.headline: Germany pledges donation for Bosnia election.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel on Monday pledged three million marks ($1.7 million) to help finance September's local elections in Bosnia.

Kinkel's ministry made the announcement after he met former Italian foreign minister Susanna Agnelli, who is responsible for securing finance for the elections on behalf of the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE).
Kinkel and Agnelli praised the OSCE's commitment to overseeing the elections and stressed their importance in returning Bosnia to normality after years of war.

Kinkel said Germany had been the second largest donor for the September 1996 general elections in Bosnia, giving eight million marks, and had been spending three billion marks a year on providing for 320,000 Bosnian refugees in Germany.
He said Germany would also make a large contribution to the OSCE mission in Bosnia and send observers to the elections.
